name: West Side Cube Clash 2023
information:
If this is your first competition, please check out the [**FAQ**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestSideCubeClash2023#27616-faq) for important notes and [**contact the organization team**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact/website?competitionId=WestSideCubeClash2023) with any further questions!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [**WCA Regulations**](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [**WCA Competition Tutorial**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf).

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group [**Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473).

This competition is supported by the [**Midwest Cubing Association**](https://midwestcubing.org/)
